entities.summary: Bartolomeo da Rinonico (fl. 1380s): A renowned Italian Franciscan chronicler and historian from Pisa, Italy. His most notable work, the 'Historia Ecclesiastica Pistorium', provides valuable insights into the religious and cultural landscape of medieval Pisa. Da Rinonico's chronicles offer a unique perspective on the city's early Christian history, its relationships with neighboring cities and the Catholic Church, and the social and economic dynamics of the region during the Late Middle Ages. His work has been extensively studied by scholars of medieval Italian history, and its historical significance extends to the wider context of Franciscan studies and the development of early modern historiography.
